title: chore(error-tracking): share the git link composer across the frontend

ticket.title: Promote the git link composer to a shared location

taskStatement:
Part of #68. Specified by #79 ([spec](https://github.com/Silthus/posthog/issues/79#issuecomment-5760343402)).

## What to build

`GitMetadataParser` becomes the one file in the repository that knows GitHub, GitLab and Bitbucket. It moves out of error tracking into a shared location and keeps its four importers working. Nothing changes on screen: a reader of the error tracking Releases surface sees the same pixels before and after. Three later tickets consume it, so it lands first.

## Write scope

- `frontend/src/lib/components/Git/**` (new home; the spec proposes this path, see Gap 3 on #79)
- `products/error_tracking/frontend/components/ReleasesPreview/**`
- `products/error_tracking/frontend/scenes/ErrorTrackingConfigurationScene/releases/Releases.tsx`
- `products/error_tracking/frontend/components/ExceptionCard/Tabs/StackTraceTab/StackTraceActions.tsx`
- `frontend/src/lib/components/Errors/Frame/framesCodeSourceLogic.ts`

No other ticket writes these paths.

## Proof gate

- [ ] `gitMetadataParser.spec.ts` moves with the file and passes with no change to an assertion
- [ ] `pnpm --filter=@posthog/frontend typescript:check` passes
- [ ] The error tracking Releases surface renders the same before and after, with both screenshots on the PR
- [ ] No re-export shim is left behind (see `/writing-ui-components`)

## Blocked by

Nothing. Starts immediately.

## Stack base and ship target

- Branch cut from `upstream/master`.
- A PR against upstream `PostHog/posthog`, opened with `--head Silthus:<branch>`. Nothing merges into the fork's `master`.
- Stacking rules from the repo `CLAUDE.md`: use `gh stack`, keep the stack shallow, merge the base before you extend it. Never run `gh stack merge`. Never force-push a branch that is in the merge queue, and that includes restacking a stack whose base is queued.
- Invoke `/writing-ui-components`, `/writing-tests`, `/reviewing-with-coderabbit` and `/writing-pr-descriptions`.


## Scope
Exactly what the ticket says: a pure move of the git link composer out of `products/error_tracking/frontend/` to the shared location the spec proposes (`frontend/src/lib/components/Git/`, confirm it against `/placing-product-frontend-code` and `/writing-ui-components`, and against `product:lint` isolation rules), update the importers, no behavior change, no new features, no widening. Keep existing comments. Minimal diff.

## Proof bundle (SHIP.md), every claim an artifact on the ticket
- Existing tests for the composer pass in the new location; if none exist, one behavior test per `/writing-tests` is allowed only if you can name the regression it catches (a broken host mapping after the move). No red/green theater for a pure move: state that plainly.
- `pnpm --filter=@posthog/frontend typescript:check`, `pnpm --filter=@posthog/frontend lint`, `hogli product:lint --all` (or the frontend equivalent that guards product isolation), and the error tracking Jest tests that import the composer, all green on the final tree. Paste command and result on the ticket.
- Render one Storybook story or the error tracking surface that uses the link before and after, with a headless browser, and attach both screenshots on the fork's orphan branch `pr-assets-workflows-read-only` (add files `wf89-*.png`, commit signed, push) embedded by raw URL. Storybook in a fresh worktree: `pnpm turbo --filter=@posthog/storybook start`; if vite shows overlay errors, build quill (`pnpm -r --filter '@posthog/quill-*' --filter '@posthog/quill' build`), ensure `node_modules/@posthog/quill` and `node_modules/@posthog/hogvm` links exist, restart. Use a port that is free (6006 and 6007 may be taken).
- Adversarial review: spawn one fresh Opus sub-agent that never saw the build, brief it with the ticket, the diff, and the proof bundle, cast to break the move (a missed importer, a lost behavior, a product isolation violation). Close every finding as fixed with the bundle re-run, or accepted with the reason on the ticket.

## Reporting
Park comment on #89 when the PR is open: PR URL, head sha, proof bundle links, review findings and their disposition, "Decisions locked so far", "Pending for the human": a maintainer must approve fork CI and enqueue. Label `wayfinder:awaiting-human`, end with `<!-- orchestration-wayfinder-cue:claude:wf68-89-implement -->`. Do not edit map #68. Do not close #89; the ticket closes only on a merged commit.

Final message to me: PR URL, head sha, one line per proof artifact, findings summary, anything you could not prove. Distilled.
